name: EPIC 210389274
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 14.9 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,802 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.89 solar masses and 14.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,367 K at its surface.
